<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Delete Pix Key</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"delete"} path={"/v1/pix/keys/{id}"}></MethodEndpoint>



Delete a pix key associated with the specified ID. After deletion, the pix key's state will be set to DELETING.
